title: The Next Tactical Edge: What Happens When Sunrisers Hyderabad Models Every Delivery?
dek: What happens when Sunrisers Hyderabad model every delivery? Commentary tags already record the length of most balls, and the economy by length points to the next tactical edge.
excerpt: Since 2024, Sunrisers Hyderabad's bowlers have out-performed the league most at one length and under-performed most at another. Delivery-level data turns that into a bowling plan.
author: CricField Editorial Desk

sections.heading: Every Delivery, Tagged
body: Ball-by-ball commentary records the length of most deliveries: yorker, full, good length, short and so on. That turns a scorecard into a dataset of bowling execution.
{{ev:te-cover}} of Sunrisers Hyderabad's deliveries since 2024 carry a length tag.

sections.heading: Where the Edge Is
body: Sunrisers Hyderabad's bowlers have out-performed the rest of the league most at {{ev:te-best}}, by {{ev:te-best-d}} runs an over, and under-performed most at {{ev:te-worst}}, by {{ev:te-worst-d}}.
The chart compares their economy at every length with the league's.

sections.heading: From Lengths to Plans
body: Yorkers make up {{ev:te-yshare}} of their tagged deliveries, against {{ev:te-ylg}} for the league. Shifting the length mix towards where they out-perform is a plan any coach can act on.

sections.heading: Limits of the Tags
body: Commentary tags are written by people in real time and are not ball-tracking; boundaries between good length and length ball are subjective. Untagged deliveries are excluded.
Economy by length also depends on phase and batter, which a fuller model would control for.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Bowl More of What Works
body: Sunrisers Hyderabad should review their length mix against the economy by length, phase by phase.
Ball-tracking data would make the next version of this analysis far more precise.
